verdict.rationale: AiPrise's marketing claims describe threshold-based auto-decisioning, auto-flagging for review, and a review queue where each case has an owner and can be assigned to an analyst or routed to Enhanced Due Diligence. That covers the core idea that borderline cases go to manual review. However, the evidence is marketing-level only and does not show what a reviewer sees or how their decisions are recorded. Missing for 10: documented display of document images, extracted fields, and check results in the review view; evidence that reviewer decisions write back into the verification record; first-party docs depth; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, borderline verifications land in a manual review queue with the full evidence — document images, extracted fields, check results — and reviewer decisions feed back into the record

citations.quote: Scoring drives auto-decisioning, with thresholds tunable per segment, geography, or product line.
